decisions.reason: The source changes artwork dimensions but does not change the requirement to document CMYK and Pantone colour references or explicitly require a Technical Sheet revision.
The exact dimensional change is owned by the separate artwork-dimensions Requirement; the production-ready delivery standard, printing method, fabric, and colour workflow remain valid unchanged.
Rescaling the pareo canvas does not change the basket-weave design direction, repeat treatment, selected variant, colour, texture, or other design attributes.
Rescaling the pareo artwork does not change the zebra pattern's selected direction, colour, stripe treatment, border treatment, or other design attributes.
The new overall artwork dimensions do not alter the mustard pareo's interior colour, black border, colour reference, or border-width options.
The new overall artwork dimensions do not alter the terracotta pareo's colour arrangement, colour reference, or border measurements.
